desc:
⚽ CAGE SOCCER: real physics street football.

🧱 Walled cage pitch
🎯 Real ball physics
🔥 Volleys, headers, overhead kicks & rainbow flicks
🛡️ Tackles, slide tackles, blocks & keeper dives
⚡ Good passes, tackles & blocks refill your stamina

CONTROLS
LMB: Shoot (quick tap = knock-on) · Hold Q + WASD: curl it
RMB: Pass · Space: Flick (no ball: jump)
Ctrl: Dribble / block stance · E: Tackle
Shift: Sprint (double-tap: burst) · Hold R: Ball cam
Controller & mobile supported

⭐ Favourite & like for updates: ranked and new modes coming!
